summary: Ghi nhớ món đồ khách vừa gọi trong chốc lát rồi chọn đúng món trao tận tay từng người.

lines: I'm run off my feet! {name}, help me remember what everyone ordered!
Once the bubble disappears, tap the customer and give them the right item.

en.text: The busy weighing stalls always need someone with a memory like yours.
